Article.ArticleTitle: Effects of creatine supplementation on maximal strength: a randomized controlled trial

Abstract.AbstractText: Creatine monohydrate supplementation significantly increased one-repetition maximum strength compared to placebo in 40 resistance-trained adults over 8 weeks.

Article.ArticleTitle: Creatine and muscle strength: a systematic review and meta-analysis

Abstract.AbstractText: This meta-analysis of 22 RCTs found creatine combined with resistance training produced greater strength gains than training alone.

Article.ArticleTitle: Creatine effects on muscle fiber in rats

Abstract.AbstractText: In this animal study, rats supplemented with creatine showed increased muscle fiber cross-sectional area.
